title: auth_passkey — WebAuthn registration/auth flow L2/L3 (GAP-020)
key_findings: Module auto-installs when base_setup and web dependencies are present
Passkey model stores credential_identifier, public_key, sign_count all restricted to base.group_system
Registration challenge: resident_key=REQUIRED, user_verification=REQUIRED — discoverable credentials only
Authentication challenge generated at /auth/passkey/start-auth (public route, no auth required)
WebAuthn challenges are 64 random bytes (secrets.token_bytes), consumed via session.pop() — single-use
Authentication bypasses MFA: _check_credentials returns mfa='skip' on success
Login resolution uses raw SQL JOIN between passkey table and users table on credential identifier
Public key stored via direct SQL UPDATE bypassing ORM field access control
Session token includes aggregated passkey key IDs — any passkey change invalidates all sessions
Three-tier record security: user rule (own records only), admin rule (read+delete all), ERP manager ACL
Deletion requires check_identity decorator + runtime owner check; blocked for cross-user attempts
Identity check dialog defaults to webauthn when user has passkeys; graceful fallback to password
Android integration: .well-known/assetlinks.json served at public endpoint for com.odoo.mobile
Vendored webauthn library enforces UV flag check and monotonic counter check internally
Attestation conveyance defaults to NONE — no attestation required from authenticator
security_groups_covered: base.group_system (field-level restriction on credential_identifier, public_key, sign_count)
base.group_user (model ACL: read+write; record rule: own records only)
base.group_portal (model ACL: read+write; record rule: own records only)
base.group_erp_manager (model ACL: read+write+delete; record rule: read+delete all)

gap_resolution.security_group_gate: COVERED — three-layer security: field groups, record rules, model ACL all evidenced
